Chasing 181 runs, GT reached 181/5 in 19.4 overs. GT skipper Shubman Gill was in top form, slamming 86 runs off 50 balls, packed with eight fours and four sixes, striking at 172.00. Meanwhile, Varun Chakaravarthy took two wickets for KKR. Gill's dismissal in the 17th over did give KKR a fighting chance. That chance was further increased after Glenn Phillips' (19) wicket in the first ball of the final over. But Shahrukh Khan (3*) and Rahul Tewatia (7*) managed to keep their composure, leading GT to a win. Earlier, Kolkata Knight Riders put on a bizarre batting display, bowled out for 180 runs in 20 overs, in their IPL 2026 fixture against Gujarat Titans in Ahmedabad on Friday. Green scored 79 runs off 55 balls, packed with seven fours and four sixes, also striking at 143.64. He lost his wicket in the final ball of the first innings to Rashid Khan. What was bizarre was that when it looked like Green could get a ton, he failed to find any support as new batters came and left within a few balls.Meanwhile, Green also had a brain fade in the final over, taking a single with KKR nine down. Kagiso Rabada struck thrice for GT, removing Tim Seifert (19), Angkrish Raghuvanshi (8) and Rinku Singh (1). Meanwhile, Mohammed Siraj removed Ajinkya Rahane for a golden duck and also got Sunil Narine's wicket for a five-ball duck.
